Virtual Appliances (VAs) for a subset of customers are currently experiencing a service disruption [resolved]
item.description: Our engineering team has successfully resolved the issue affecting Virtual Appliances (VAs) for customers in the us-east-1 region who utilize the Canal secure tunnel VPN configuration. To fully restore your connectivity, action is required on your part. Our team has issued updated SSL Certificates that must be applied to your configuration. Please download the certificates from https://community.sailpoint.com/t5/IdentityNow-Connectors/Virtual-Appliance-Network-Tunnel-Configuration/ta-p/274648 and follow the instructions. Please note: if you have recently downloaded the certificate bundle before, you may need to clear your browser cache to get the updated files. If you have completed the steps above and are still experiencing issues, please open a support ticket.
